fact: The restructuring paper (data to December 2025) reports about 5,300 villages surveyed for the RSU, 225,000 households registered on demand in 2025 and 287 guichets opened, while the aim is to get the RSU used for targeting across government programmes.
title: Restructuring Paper, Côte d'Ivoire Productive Social Safety Nets System Strengthening Program (P175594)
